name: control-aa-batteries
note: Amazon Basics 20-Pack AA Alkaline Batteries, ASIN B00NTCH52W. Captured 2026-08-03 at rung 1 (impersonated HTTP, no browser), HTTP 200, 3,201,313 B raw. IN STOCK: `#availability` reads a flat `In Stock`, `<input id="add-to-cart-button" value="Add to cart">` is present and not disabled, buy-box price $9.99 headline (with -5% one-time and -15% Subscribe & Save options below it), and the `Shipper / Seller` offer-display feature reads the verbatim string `Amazon.com` — the value FIRST_PARTY['amazon'] is set from. Amazon ships NO structured data on /dp/: zero application/ld+json, no __NEXT_DATA__, and no JSON blob on the page carrying a price, an availability or a seller, so this fixture exists to exercise the add-to-cart DOM reader, which is the only thing on the page there is to read. REDACTED BEFORE COMMIT, by class rather than by value — 03.1-02's lesson applied before a leak instead of after one. The raw capture carried Amazon's geolocation of this host — the city (x3) and the ZIP (x6), deliberately not named here for the same reason the values were removed from the page, a `session-id`, an `anti-csrftoken-a2z`, ten offer-listing tokens, an `x-amz-rid` request id and two request timestamps. Redaction: every <script> body emptied, every <style> body emptied, every HTML comment dropped, the value of every input whose name contains csrf/session-id/offerListingId/offeringID/pageLoadTimestamp/merchantID/customerId blanked, pf_rd_r-family request ids and 3-7-7 session ids replaced, and every host marker replaced with REDACTED. A DOM reader needs element markup, not the retailer's session state, so this costs the fixture nothing it is used for. `bytes` is the redacted size; the raw figure is in this note.
